reason: The 'no effect' conclusion rests on an unjustified restriction to the north region (and 1% trimming). On the full sample, adjusted for the same controls, remote_share has a positive, significant effect (0.75, SE 0.23, p=0.001). Central and south regions are also significant (p=0.04 and p=0.008), and the north estimate is imprecise (SE 0.40), so it can't show absence of an effect.
